incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered -> service=prod-inference-gateway | alert=PD123456 | symptom=5xx_rate_spike | region=us-west1 | started=2025-11-12T02:13:50Z <https://pagerduty.example/PD123456|view>
alice (oncall): acked. i'm oncall — pulling logs and assigning SRE to investigate.
bob_sre: grabbing traces. initial signal shows upstream 502s from kvcache proxies, eviction spikes around 02:11. 12% 5xx over the last 3m, p50 latency +200ms.
carol-platform: i'm scaling up dedicated pool in us-west1 (+2 nodes) and prepping a partial failover to us-east-1. any chance this is recent deploy? :eyes:
dave-support: seeing ~350 customer errors hitting support queue. prepping a customer status note. will coordinate once we know cause.
bob_sre: quick mitigation attempt: disable kvcache prefetch and relax connection limits to avoid thundering. pushing config now:

```
route: /v1/generate
kvcache.prefetch: false
kvcache.eviction_threshold: 0.75
service.max_connections: 600
```
alice (oncall): applied the config change at 02:16:05. monitoring dashboards — errors falling to ~6%.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD123456 acknowledged by alice (oncall) at 2025-11-12T02:16:20Z
carol-platform: can we rollback the canary that went out 02:00? it increased average prompt length and seems correlated with cache pressure.
bob_sre: initiating rollback via deployer: rolling v2025-11-12-canary -> v2025-11-05-main.
alice (oncall): rollback completed at 02:22:40. continuing partial failover: routing 20% traffic to us-east-1 for safety, leaving 80% on primary.
dave-support: posted interim status: "We’re investigating increased errors for inference requests in us-west1. Mitigations in progress; recommend retrying requests. No data loss reported."
bob_sre: error rate now ~2.1% and trending downward. keeping the routing change for 15 more minutes to validate.
alice (oncall): noted. will hand off to night shift in 30m if stable. please add post-incident followups.
bob_sre: filing follow-up ticket INF-4521: "Investigate KV cache eviction behavior with recent canary; add alert for eviction_rate and prewarm strategy." added runbook note to increase pre-warm for 3kb prefixes.
carol-platform: also recommend adding an automated rollback condition for canary if eviction_rate > 0.5 over 5m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD123456 resolved by alice (oncall) at 2025-11-12T02:40:10Z (auto-resolve verified). :white_check_mark:
alice (oncall): closing thread. thumbs to everyone who jumped in. :thumbsup:
